mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_record (user_id, category_id, exam_date, hospital, doctor, notes, image_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{examDate}, #{hospital}, #{doctor}, #{notes}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRecords, MIN(r.exam_date) AS firstDate, MAX(r.exam_date) AS lastDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record x ON x.id = v.record_id WHERE x.user_id = #{userId} AND v.value_decimal IS NOT NULL) AS totalValues, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record x ON x.id = v.record_id WHERE x.user_id = #{userId} AND v.is_abnormal != 0) AS abnormalValues FROM exam_record r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_category c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT i.name AS name, i.unit AS unit, COUNT(*) AS times FROM exam_value v JOIN exam_record r ON r.id = v.record_id JOIN exam_indicator i ON i.id = v.indicator_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND v.is_abnormal != 0 GROUP BY i.id, i.name, i.unit ORDER BY times DESC LIMIT #{limit}
